goal: Run unlike systems with their own local state through one shared cross-layer handoff carrier: Personal Operations, Online School, and a state-driven Factory System now emit/reconcile handoffs without collapsing their local schemas.
next_movement: Derive the common system-adapter interface from the demonstrated systems and build a generic orchestrator that can ask registered systems for ready handoffs, route them through eligible actors/adapters, reconcile results back to the originating system, and preserve all event/evidence boundaries.
walls: Do not redefine A/B as the runtime, orchestrator, system interface, factory, school, planner, or activation layer.
Do not flatten system-local schemas into the shared Handoff carrier; the carrier exists at boundaries.
Do not let activations manufacture work; they project supported live handoffs.
Do not promote notes/plans to tasks or tasks to handoffs without the relevant explicit admission.
Do not treat school task completion as learner mastery without separate evidence.
Do not upgrade factory simulation evidence to physical/measurement evidence.
Do not hard-code downstream factory handoffs before the preceding system state has reconciled.

handoff.reason: The user explicitly backed out of the school implementation layer and generalized the repo into a translation/evidence spine with cross-layer handoffs, then directed implementation of the shared handoff runtime.
